meta_description:
624 likes, 10 comments - cntraveler on October 30, 2026: "From our Archives (and for some Halloween inspo): The Power of Travel to Transform. Following the stylish wake of Hollywood dramas about high-seas assumed identities, former style director @markreiki set sail on the Queen Victoria from @cunardline in 2008. There, @henrybourne introduced us to the characters on board:

Slide 1: The Chameleon. Guess who? An air of mystery near Geiranger, Norway.

Slide 2: The Dilettante. Ladies and gentlemen, in the Art Deco Champagne Bar, the house bubbly is Veuve Cliquot.

Slide 3: The Seductress. Mrs. Robinson, I presume? Tea on Deck 3.

Slide 4: The Bombshell. Gentlemen prefer blondes.

Slide 5: The Star. Anchors aweigh...dockside in Bergen, gateway to Norway's fjords.

Slide 6: The Comedienne. Tennis, anyone? 

Slide 7: The Starlet. Reel glamour.

Slide 8: The Vamp. Shall we dance? The Queens Room hosts high tea by day and ballroom moves by night.

Slide 9: The Diva.

Our brand was first published in 1987, and has since become a global authority on the best luxury travel experiences.".
